meta.description: Loads mass-spectrometry data into Python/R and strips the search engine's bookkeeping before any number is trusted -- removes decoys (REV__/Reverse), contaminants (CON__/Potential contaminant), Only-identified-by-site groups, and resolves semicolon razor/leading protein-ID ambiguity in MaxQuant proteinGroups.txt, DIA-NN report.parquet, and mzML/mzXML. Distinguishes Intensity (raw) vs LFQ intensity (MaxLFQ) vs iBAQ, treats a MaxQuant zero as missing (NaN, not log2(-inf)), and inherits the acquisition mode's missingness contract (DDA MNAR vs DIA MCAR). Use when starting an analysis from raw spectra or a search engine output. Downstream normalization and stats are differential-abundance; reporter-ion/MaxLFQ quant is quantification; protein grouping is protein-inference.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated DOIs, PMIDs or results; the four references are real papers. pyOpenMS is attributed to Chambers 2012 (ProteoWizard), a misattribution rather than a fabrication (P2).

practice_boundaries.detail: Instrument/search-engine data only; no individual-level diagnosis, prescription or triage in any output.

methodological_ground.detail: Missing experiment-wide protein FDR and the DIA-MCAR label are real errors (P1) but do not invert conclusions: run-level 1% FDR is still applied and DDA routing to left-censored imputation is correct. No ethics trigger.

code_usability.detail: All 4 SKILL.md Python blocks parse and ran on pandas 3.0.5 / pyOpenMS 3.5.0; shipped example exits 0. The only crash is an unguarded getPrecursors()[0] on precursor-less MS2 scans (edge input).

functional_suitability.note: Completeness 3, Correctness 2, Appropriateness 4. MaxQuant block correct; DIA-NN filter omits Global.PG.Q.Value (60 LOWCONF groups leak), DIA block lacks 0->NaN, DIA-MCAR claim contradicted by its own diagnostic, mzML loop crashes on precursor-less MS2, pyOpenMS cited to Chambers 2012; R route named without code.

reliability.note: Fault tolerance 2, Error reporting 3, Recoverability 3. .get() flag guards and Gene names guard work; nothing catches empty getPrecursors(), a table without LFQ columns (silently returns ID-only matrix) or DIA zeros; good Common Errors table.

recommendations.title: DIA-NN import omits Global.PG.Q.Value filter
recommendations.problem: Following the DIA block and its threshold table, all 60 LOWCONF groups (Global.PG.Q.Value 0.04) enter the cross-run matrix (6.3% of rows, 116 cells).
recommendations.root_cause: The import filter is run-level only (Q.Value and PG.Q.Value), unlike the sibling dia-analysis Skill and DIA-NN guidance for cross-run matrices.
recommendations.fix: Add (report['Global.PG.Q.Value'] <= 0.01) (or Lib.PG.Q.Value for library-based MBR) to the DIA code, the Quantitative Thresholds row and the Stale DIA-NN parsing fix.

recommendations.title: DIA missingness labelled MCAR against own diagnostic
recommendations.problem: assess_missingness gives DIA the same MNAR signature as DDA (-0.66 vs -0.62; missing cells in the lowest abundance quartile), yet the Decision Tree routes DIA to 'MCAR / standard imputers'.
recommendations.root_cause: Imputation class is keyed to acquisition mode instead of the diagnostic, and the MCAR claim has no supporting citation.
recommendations.fix: State that DIA has less but still mostly intensity-dependent missingness; choose the imputer from the diagnostic; cite a missing-value source (e.g. msImpute 2023).

recommendations.title: DIA block keeps PG.MaxLFQ zeros (-inf after log2)
recommendations.problem: 61 PG.MaxLFQ zeros pass into the pivot and become -inf at log2; run verbatim on the linear matrix the diagnostic reads -0.16 instead of -0.66.
recommendations.root_cause: The zero->NaN rule and log2 step are written for MaxQuant only.
recommendations.fix: After the pivot add matrix = np.log2(matrix.replace(0, np.nan)) and state that assess_missingness expects a log2 matrix with NaN for missing.

recommendations.title: mzML loop crashes on MS2 scans without precursor
recommendations.problem: spectrum.getPrecursors()[0] raises IndexError on an AIF/bbCID-style MS2 scan; missing isolation offsets are reported as width 0.
recommendations.root_cause: The loop assumes every MS2 spectrum carries a precursor with written isolation offsets.
recommendations.fix: Guard with precs = spectrum.getPrecursors(); if not precs: record as no-precursor and continue; warn when lower+upper offset == 0.

recommendations.title: R route named but no QFeatures code given
recommendations.problem: readQFeatures exists in QFeatures 1.16.0 but the Skill gives no code; filterFeatures on MaxQuant flag names with spaces errors.
recommendations.root_cause: R path is one line in the Tool Taxonomy and Decision Tree.
recommendations.fix: Add a short QFeatures block: readQFeatures(quantCols=...), make.names on rowData before filterFeatures, zeroIsNA, logTransform; note aggregateFeatures is for peptide-to-protein only.

recommendations.title: Silent failure modes in the MaxQuant block
recommendations.problem: With no LFQ columns the block returns an ID-only matrix without error; 55 all-NaN rows are kept; the listed >=2-peptide threshold is not applied.
recommendations.root_cause: No input validation or post-load checks in the code block.
recommendations.fix: Stop if lfq_cols is empty, drop rows with no valid values, and either apply or drop the >=2-peptide threshold.

recommendations.title: pyOpenMS misattributed to Chambers 2012
recommendations.problem: The Tool Taxonomy cites the ProteoWizard paper for pyOpenMS.
recommendations.root_cause: Citation copied from the msconvert row.
recommendations.fix: Cite Rost et al. 2014 (Proteomics) for pyOpenMS.
